Hi Olivia / team,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to get a sense of your environment and the key constraints (regulated PHI workloads, regional isolation, and a hard SLA requirement for peak hours). Quick recap & next steps: 

- Goal for next call: technical environment walkthrough + access requirements so we can size a Private deployment + confirm integration points for auth and telemetry.
- We should have your infra lead + product owner + one security contact on the call.

Could you confirm who will join from MedSys and which of the two windows below works best for you? I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees and bridge preference (Google Meet vs Zoom).

Option A: Tue Apr 13 — 09:00–10:00 PT
Option B: Wed Apr 14 — 11:00–12:00 PT

Also attaching a short ops pack and an architecture diagram that outline the items we’ll walk through (networking, KMS integration, audit logs). If you have any pre-reqs (test dataset access, service account), please flag them and we’ll add to the invite.

Attachments: medsys-mvp-ops-pack.pdf, redwood-arch-diagram.png

Thanks,
